instruction.text: Sort the decimals from the largest at the top to the smallest at the bottom.

trainers.hint: Compare the decimal numbers place by place. If the digit in the ones place is the same for two numbers, compare the digits in the tenths place and so on until the digits are different.

instruction.text: Select the decimal numbers in order of size. Start with the smallest.

hint.text:
Mentally expand the numbers with fewer decimal places by adding 0s, so that all numbers have the same number of decimal places. For example: ||1.785|| ||1.923|| ||1.3
→||1.785|| ||1.923|| ||1.300
